verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform covering customers, accounts, cards, payments, KYC and webhooks, not an AI agent or assistant host that would consume tools from MCP servers. The MCP-client axis is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an agent that could connect to MCP servers; its llms.txt and OpenAPI spec only expose its own docs and API.
